ideas.title: Investigating the Alex Pretti Shooting
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the shooting of Alex Pretti in Minneapolis, including the use of force by federal agents and the Trump administration's response to the incident.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti?
How did the Trump administration respond to the incident?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a pattern of excessive use of force by federal agents and a lack of accountability by the Trump administration.

ideas.title: Uncovering Voter Suppression in Minnesota
ideas.description: An investigation into the Trump administration's demand for Minnesota's voter rolls and the potential for voter suppression and election interference.
questions: What is the purpose of the Trump administration's demand for Minnesota's voter rolls?
How will the demand for voter rolls affect the upcoming election?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a pattern of voter suppression and election interference by the Trump administration.
